findings.description: The requirement specifies behavior at exact equality and names test as its verification method, but CON-SUP-127 requires verification margins of at least 200 µs on either side of the limit. Those margin tests cannot establish the equality behavior.
findings.requested_change: Resolve the equality verification conditions and update the requirement or its verification method accordingly.
